title: Botanic man. - Volume 1: Episodes 1-4.
creator_credit: Robert Fleming, Graeme Duckham, Randal Beattie and Thames Television International
brief_description: A compilation of David Bellamy’s “Greenprint for life”, “The Crucible of life”, “Living Water”, and “Potential energy”. Contents include Amazon rain forest ecology, the emergence of the earliest life forms, marine ecology and the Peruvian trench, the evolutionary transition from sea to land and its legacy of peat and coal deposits.
